plugin.note: Pyrefiends have 45 hitpoints and a max hit of 4 and are 100% weak to water spells; magic is the fastest style. They have the demon attribute, so demonbane weapons apply. No protective item is needed in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, but the Smoke Dungeon requires a facemask or Slayer helmet.

requirements: 30 Slayer is required for pyrefiend assignments.
A facemask or Slayer helmet is required only when fighting them in the Smoke Dungeon.
mechanics: Pyrefiends have 45 hitpoints and a max hit of 4.
They attack with magic-based melee (magic level 1) and are 100% weak to water spells (0 magic defence).
Fiery and demon attributes - demonbane weapons apply.

methods.label: Magic (water spells)
methods.summary: Cast water spells at pyrefiends to exploit their 100% water weakness for the fastest kills.
requiredOrKeyItems: A staff or trident casting water spells
steps: Travel to the pyrefiend area of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (no facemask needed).
Cast water spells until the task is complete.

methods.label: Melee
methods.summary: Melee pyrefiends with any weapon; slower than magic but needs no runes.
requiredOrKeyItems: A demonbane weapon boosts damage (demon attribute)
steps: Travel to a pyrefiend spawn (Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, or the Smoke Dungeon with a facemask).
Attack with a melee weapon until the task is complete.
